notes.title: 🎄 Steam Update - December 2024 🎅
notes.notes:
To celebrate this holiday season, we've integrated your suggestions, along with a great discount so you can enjoy it this Christmas.


- More Light
- More Speed
- More Scares

notes.title: Patch Notes: Spanish Language Integration and Significant Improvement
notes.notes:
In this update, we've integrated support for the Spanish language, enhancing accessibility for our Spanish-speaking players. 
Additionally, we've made significant improvements, including fixes to general lighting, adjustments to gameplay, a deeper exploration of the lore, and added scares to enhance the game's excitement. 

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Community Request Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to our Twitter friends for the suggestions about our game. Thanks to them, we have fixed the following issues:

-Integration options for FPS optimization VSync -120fps- 60fps
-Correction in the clues of the final puzzle
-Simple loading screen
-Restructuring of the options screen

Thanks to @CarltonTheWelsh, @TheAllieGShow_, @JonathanDubsky, @RealMischiefX. There is still a lot to fix, and we will be working on it.Thanks!!

notes.title: Last Update waiting for KickStarter Campaign
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We have fixed a large portion of the initial bugs in our first horror game. In this latest update, we have significantly improved the gameplay to make it more intuitive.

- Improved instructions for the backyard level
- Enhancements in mechanics
- Speed improvements
- More scares
- Fix bugs colliders 

We hope you enjoy it!

Stay tuned for updates on our Kickstarter campaign on our Twitter page: https://twitter.com/bross_lab

notes.title: September Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we bring you a new update with significant changes for Nocturia.

I hope you enjoy it.
